content.title: Chapter 3
content.subtitle: Inclusive and effective institutions and Civic Engagement
content.body: Thank you for joining us for the third chapter of the Just Energy Transition Module. We invite you to interact with the closing scenario, and to reflect on how you can take action to move these ideas from ambitions into action.

nextBlock.title: Chapter 4: Appropriate and Independent Oversight
nextBlock.cta: This chapter highlights independent, agile oversight in energy governance to ensure transparency, gender equality, accountability, and adaptability in just energy transition.
